# 💬 Welcome to the Demon Time Exotics Discussions!

**THE MESSY SHOW — community hub for the repo behind the brand** 💪🏾😈🔥

This is where the code community talks. The *content* community lives on
[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DTEMONEY448) — and every comment counts
there too. 😈

## 🗂️ How To Use The Categories

| Category | Post What? |
|---|---|
| 🗣️ **General** | Everything DTE — site, apps, the movement, tap-in talk |
| 💡 **Ideas** | Feature proposals too rough for a formal Feature Request — we'll refine together |
| 🙏 **Q&A** | Questions about running, building, or forking the repo — check [FAQ.md](https://github.com/DTEMONEY448/demon-time-exotics/blob/main/FAQ.md) first |
| 🙌 **Show and tell** | You forked it for your own channel? YOU BUILT SOMETHING? Show us. Always welcome. |
| 😈 **Polls** | Community votes — which app next, which feature first |

## ✅ Before You Post

1. **Search** — your topic may already have a thread
2. **Read the docs** — a lot lives in [README](https://github.com/DTEMONEY448/demon-time-exotics) → Documentation table: INSTALL, BUILD, DEPLOYMENT, FAQ, usage
3. **Right venue** — 🐛 bugs → [Issues](https://github.com/DTEMONEY448/demon-time-exotics/issues) (Bug Report template) • 🔒 security → [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/DTEMONEY448/demon-time-exotics/blob/main/SECURITY.md) — **never a public post**
4. **Code of Conduct applies** — [read it](https://github.com/DTEMONEY448/demon-time-exotics/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Keep it respectful; keep it real.

## 🔥 Ground Rules

- **No scripts, no filters — but no slurs, harassment, or doxxing.** Ever.
- Debate the code, not the commenter
- Drama coverage belongs on the channel — repo discussions stay on-topic to
  *this repository*
- Promote your DTE fork/derivative freely in Show and tell — that's what
  this repo is FOR
- The maintainers read everything; owner chimes in on brand decisions

## 🚀 Want to Contribute Code?

Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/DTEMONEY448/demon-time-exotics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Good first picks: issues labeled `good first issue`.
